description: This file declares the HdmiInput class, which implements a plugin for HDMI input management within a WPEFramework environment. It includes method declarations for handling HDMI devices, EDID reading/writing, event handling, and plugin interfacing features. The file primarily focuses on interface definition, class structure, and method signatures.

classes.name: HdmiInput
